europe_now.title: French student protests turn violent, hundreds of schools closed
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of French schools remained closed as student protests escalated into violence across the country. Fires have broken out at schools during the nationwide demonstrations.

sources.headline: Hundreds of French schools remain closed as student protests turn violent
Fires break out at French schools as students protest nationwide

europe_now.title: Russia continues strikes on Kyiv as capital faces renewed bombardment
europe_now.summary: Russian forces hit Kyiv’s Southern Bridge while Moscow continued to pound the capital in ongoing attacks. The live reporting highlights the sustained security threat facing the Ukrainian capital.

sources.headline: Live: Russia hits Kyiv’s Southern Bridge as Moscow continues to pound capital

top_stories.title: EU and Ukraine accelerate loan payout schedule
top_stories.summary: The European Union and Ukraine have agreed to accelerate a €45 billion loan payout scheduled for 2027. This financial support aims to provide resources to Ukraine sooner than the original timeline.

sources.headline: EU, Ukraine agree to accelerate €45B loan payout in 2027

top_stories.title: US demands European diesel reserves amid export ban threat
top_stories.summary: The United States has pressed Europe to release diesel reserves immediately, threatening an export ban if demands are not met. European leaders are developing a countermeasure to address the economic pressure and fuel supply concerns.

sources.headline: US presses Europe to release 'immediately' diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban

top_stories.title: Turkey stock market scandal affects nearly half a million investors
top_stories.summary: A stock market scandal in Turkey has affected nearly half a million investors, leading to police arrests and the resignation of an AKP politician. The financial turmoil has prompted investigations into the dealings involved.

sources.headline: Turkey's stock market scandal affects nearly half a million investors. Police have made several arrests and an AKP politician has resigned.

top_stories.title: Failed Leipzig attack reveals wider Russian campaign
top_stories.summary: A failed attack in Leipzig has revealed a wider Russian campaign of attacks targeting the region. This finding expands the understanding of the scope of Russian operations in the region.

sources.headline: How a failed attack in Leipzig revealed a wider Russian campaign of attacks
